message.reasoning:
The user asks "Where is the closest Italian restaurant?" We need location-based info. There's no tool for geolocation or map queries. According to policy, we cannot provide location-based answers unless there's an official API. So we should refuse and offer general suggestions.

We can say: I don't have real-time data on restaurants; you might use Google Maps etc. Provide some generic advice but not specific location. That satisfies refusal style guidelines.
